scope.bounded_practice: wholly synthetic museum-zone wayfinding topology registrar and accessible handover

operations.hypothesis: Validate the exact finite preorder and its Alexandrov-space record.
Enumerate every upward-closed open set and its cardinality census.
Enumerate every closed complement and its cardinality census.
Compute the exact interior of every subset.
Compute the exact closure of every subset.
Compute closure-minus-interior boundary signatures for every subset.
Recover the finite specialization preorder without interpreting it as physical causality.
Bind each point to its exact minimal open neighborhood.
Compute finite connected components from the comparability graph.
Prove that minimal neighborhoods regenerate the declared topology.
Check inverse images of open sets for one declared finite self-map.
Compute a permutation-minimal preorder signature and automorphism count.
Construct the exact subspace topology after removing one synthetic point.
Construct the Kolmogorov-equivalence quotient topology.
Count open sets in the finite product with the two-point Sierpinski space.
Expose topological indistinguishability and the finite T0 quotient.
Render a deterministic plain-language summary and exact fallback row count.
Represent missing observational uncertainty without inventing an estimate.
Keep real wayfinding, affected-user, and independent evidence visibly absent.
Hold every real publication, safety, accessibility-conformance, legal, cultural, and Maori-authority act.

novelty_boundary: Immediate-source direct comparison only; no universal originality or theorem claim.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Open-set closure
hypothesized_laws.claim: Declared open sets contain the empty and full sets and are closed under finite union and intersection.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Interior contractiveness
hypothesized_laws.claim: Every finite interior is contained in its source subset.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: An interior contains a point outside its subset.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Closure extensiveness
hypothesized_laws.claim: Every finite closure contains its source subset.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: A source point is absent from its closure.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Boundary definition
hypothesized_laws.claim: Boundary equals closure minus interior for every declared subset.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: One exact subset violates the difference identity.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Specialization recovery
hypothesized_laws.claim: Upward-open enumeration recovers the frozen preorder.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: The recovered relation differs from the request.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Neighborhood basis
hypothesized_laws.claim: Minimal point neighborhoods generate every declared open set.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: An open set cannot be generated by basis unions.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Component partition
hypothesized_laws.claim: Comparability components partition every synthetic point once.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: A point is lost or duplicated.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Continuity preimage
hypothesized_laws.claim: A self-map is continuous exactly when every open preimage is open.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: The certificate disagrees with exhaustive preimages.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Canonical relabeling
hypothesized_laws.claim: The minimum relation bitstring is invariant under point relabeling.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: A relabeling changes the minimum signature.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Subspace construction
hypothesized_laws.claim: Intersecting source opens with the chosen subset yields the exact subspace topology.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: A projected open is missing or extra.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Quotient saturation
hypothesized_laws.claim: Quotient opens correspond exactly to saturated source opens.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: A quotient open has nonopen preimage or a valid preimage is omitted.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Product order
hypothesized_laws.claim: Product opens agree with upward closure under the componentwise preorder.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: T0 quotient
hypothesized_laws.claim: Collapsing mutually comparable points yields a T0 finite quotient.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Digest stability
hypothesized_laws.claim: Stable serialization gives the same digest for identical finite evidence.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Authority nonpromotion
hypothesized_laws.claim: Finite topology software never becomes a real route, accessibility, safety, legal, cultural, or Maori-authority decision.

open_problem_probes.question: Which real environments could be studied only after lawful purpose, consent, provenance, and affected-party review?
Which spatial semantics distinguish a useful adjacency model from a misleading route abstraction?
How should uncertainty, missingness, closure, and inaccessible regions be represented without conflation?
What independent implementation would reproduce every finite-space certificate and adjudicate discrepancies?
What usability evidence is required before a topology-inspired interface can support a real visitor?
Which assistive-technology and affected-user evaluations are needed beyond static structure?
How should dynamic closures and temporary route restrictions be versioned and corrected?
Which professional roles may approve a real wayfinding or evacuation representation?
What security and privacy boundaries apply to occupancy or movement information?
How should multilingual labels and cultural place meanings be governed?
Who may contest a route representation and receive correction or remedy?
Which tangata whenua, iwi, hapu, and Maori data-governance processes apply to relevant places?
How should provenance be preserved without converting lineage into truth or authority?
What monitoring and rollback evidence is required for any live deployment?
What preregistered real-world study and independent review would be needed before an effectiveness claim?

successor_practices: independently compare preorder and open-set formulations without inheriting execution credit
study finite continuity witnesses while holding real navigation and safety authority open
evaluate accessible summaries only through manual and affected-user evidence
preserve topology provenance without converting structural adjacency into trust or authority
